description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Cancellation of License Issued under the Finance Business Act, No. 42 of 2011 to Bimputh Finance Ltd
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the cancellation of a finance business license under the Finance Business Act, No. 42 of 2011. It deals with regulatory action by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka regarding financial institution licensing, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes. The content focuses on regulatory compliance and enforcement of existing legislation.
